task_specification.objective: Deliver three closure-ready product increments: restore a larger, coherent cemetery with stable landmark collision and visibility; replace prose-stacked upgrade choices with an authored, truthful, fully focusable interface; and complete the ordinary five-wave Bellkeeper run with unambiguous Escape ownership and clean terminal lifecycle.

diagnosis.root_cause: Release convergence is blocked by overlapping spatial ownership and ambiguous input ownership: MausoleumCollision remains valid gameplay collision but is also treated as the first camera-coverage occluder for all three landmarks, while physical Escape is declared by both pause and ui_cancel. Separately, the required upgrade decision surface and ordinary five-wave terminal route still need candidate-bound completion rather than more qualification-only work.

stop_conditions: Do not replace, split, duplicate, extract, or edit the preserved intact authored cemetery package or its raw imported children; repair wrappers, bindings, collision, outer datum, camera ownership, and authoritative gameplay systems around it.
Do not schedule deferred dense-profile, collector-rebind, or diagnostic-route findings as current issue dispositions; they receive only non-blocking regression patrol where relevant.

If the intact authored package cannot safely support the required expansion, preserve it, leave the world issue open, and report the concrete constraint instead of claiming a no-op repair or substituting fog, sky, or color changes for external world geometry.
Stop development after focused code checks and candidate runtime preparation are complete; GameLoop Runtime and Tester own recapture, formal gap verdicts, issue closure, and phase closure.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause strategy from repeated transform tuning: isolate gameplay collision from camera visibility classification through explicit collider-to-visual bindings, extend the product-owned spatial wrapper without altering the intact map, rebuild the real choice-page hierarchy at its scene/controller boundary, and give Escape plus wave/result transitions single authoritative owners. This creates direct black-box and white-box retests for both active regressions while advancing the selected player-facing shell capability.

code: Run focused Godot parse/resource-load checks for every modified scene and script; verify all NodePaths, signals, typed resources, collision masks, and authoritative snapshot fields resolve without errors.
Inspect project.godot and runtime InputMap state to prove physical keycode 4194305 has one owner, then inspect context routing for gameplay, draft, pause, settings/help, result, and title.

Check the wave data and state graph for exactly five ordinary waves, one elite route, one Bellkeeper request/spawn/defeat sequence, exactly-once terminal commit, spawn shutdown after terminal state, and complete Retry disposal/reset.
Verify upgrade projection filters ineligible and unchanged fields, emits at most three truthful deltas per card, and applies one selected stable id/rank/modifier before unpausing.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime and Tester recapture the arena at spawn, critical route, before/near/after each landmark, and four cardinal perimeter positions; pair screenshots with spatial bounds, camera coverage, collision contacts, player/enemy movement replay, navigation/spawn containment, and before/after time-to-cross.

Tester opens the upgrade draft at 1920x1080 and supported UI scales, captures keyboard, mouse, and gamepad states, selects each offer class, and compares rendered current-to-new values with the authoritative selected-build snapshot and exactly-once resume transaction.
Tester executes logical and physical Escape across gameplay, draft, pause, settings/help, result, and title, confirming one transition per press and retained gamepad pause/back behavior.

Tester runs the ordinary five-wave route through Bellkeeper victory, a separate ordinary failure, Result, Retry, and Title; capture wave/boss/terminal/reset snapshots and runtime logs at each checkpoint. Diagnostic preparation cannot satisfy this route matrix.
visual: Compare shipped arena captures with the bound reference for high-angle framing, dense but navigable cemetery composition, warm lantern against cool moonlight, readable landmarks/enemies, clear escape lanes, and compact HUD; reject voids, primitive external dressing, floating props, and whole-landmark disappearance.

Inspect the choice page as a decision interface: dominant silhouettes/icons, concise copy, aligned truthful values, no more than three relevant deltas, visible non-color-only focus states, stable card dimensions, and no clipping or generic text-pile styling.

Inspect Result and Retry presentation for complete statistics, build summary, correct victory/failure identity, preserved focus hierarchy, and absence of stale HUD, boss bar, pause overlay, actors, or effects.
Re-run host_godot_boot and native_godot_project preservation checks after candidate changes; formal pass/fail and issue closure remain Tester-owned.

done_when: The product-owned wrapper has an expanded or larger traversable scale than the current baseline, with bound before/after playable extents and ordinary time-to-cross; collision, navigation, spawn lanes, and the boundary agree with visible walkable geometry.

A coherent non-playable external world or external depth containing actual cemetery geometry or authored silhouettes continues beyond several perimeter edges; it exposes no black void, abrupt empty edge, proxy floor, or visible PrimitiveMesh/CSG stand-in under the shipped camera.

The keeper post, central building or mausoleum landmark, and cracked moon bell have aligned visible footprints and collision, remain readable before approach, at near contact, and after departure, and never undergo whole-landmark disappearance or occlusion while gameplay-relevant.

Ordinary movement and representative enemy movement replay against every side of the central landmark and along the full perimeter cannot pass through geometry, become hidden inside it, escape the boundary, or lose a recoverable movement lane.

Spawn, critical route, near-contact, departure, and four cardinal perimeter views retain the reference target's high-angle framing, warm-versus-cool hierarchy, readable silhouettes, external depth, and clear escape lanes.
tasks.instructions: Repair the authored cemetery at its existing scene, spatial-contract, camera, and spawn-wrapper owners. Preserve the single intact map instance. First bind the MausoleumCollision collider and the matching mausoleum visual explicitly, then isolate the gameplay collision layer from camera-visibility queries so the collider cannot falsely occlude the keeper post, mausoleum, and bell; use bounded selective transparency only when the actual intervening visual obstructs the player, never whole-landmark hiding. Expand the product-owned outer datum to a larger traversable scale, align navigation and spawn exclusions, and add coherent non-playable external world depth beyond the collision perimeter without making it reachable or spawnable. This must be a real bound product change, not transform-only tuning or an environment-color adjustment. Keep the existing authored environment as the justified singleton; product-owned outer datum, collision, navigation, spawn/objective anchors, and boundaries are additive integration work, not permission to duplicate or reposition authored child meshes.
